title: Normalized Cartier Kummer family interfaces
statement: For a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, use the finite quotient coefficients and the published pro-etale Tate sheaves of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed, def-amb-proetale-supported-coefficient-reduction]. Define CartierEtaleKummerFamily to be the supported degree-two etale Ext arrows for every positive annihilating exponent and every Cartier immersion. Its normalization is SupportedKummerBoundary [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]; its reduction is SupportedKummerScalar [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-scalar]. CartierKummerRealization compares such a family to CartierKummerFamily by an invertible supported-source comparison preserving the constant quotient and a root-projection-normalized finite Tate site comparison [def-amb-finite-tate-site-comparison-data]. CartierKummerChern requires the ordinary integral Kummer Chern equation and its transported forgetting-support equation. CartierKummerBaseChange requires the supported-constant and root-normalized Tate comparison square for every Cartier-preserving pullback. These are the unchanged definitions formerly in lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map, with all their universes and quantifiers retained.
